switches.summary: Linear full-POM magnetic keyboard switch with 30 gf initial force, 3.8 mm total travel, published magnetic-flux positions and a 100M-cycle life.

sources.label: Kailh Magnetic Keyboard Switch product page

compatibility: Requires a keyboard/PCB with magnetic sensing and firmware calibrated for Kailh CPG1515M01D01; physical MX-style fit alone does not establish electrical/sensing compatibility.

specification.note: Kailh publishes CPG1515M01D01 as a linear full-POM magnetic switch with 30±10 gf initial force, 3.8 +0/-0.4 mm total travel, 100M-cycle life, initial-position flux 100±15 Gs and total-travel-position flux 2000±150 Gs. The page does not claim universal board compatibility, so Atlas keeps compatibility conditional on the target sensor/firmware implementation.

switches.summary: Silent tactile mechanical switch with 45 gf operating force, 60 gf bottom force, 2.0 mm pre-travel, 4.0 mm total travel and a 70M-cycle published life.

sources.label: Kailh Midnight MX Silent Tactile product page

specification.note: Kailh publishes 45±10 gf operation force, 60 gf bottom force, 2.0±0.4 mm conduct travel, 4.0±0.4 mm total travel and 70M cycles. Kailh also describes silicone silencing elements in the upper cover/base and a dust-proof design.
